notes: Version 2.3. Corrects attributions about the amplitude ratio r(c,q): O16 proves the doubling of the exponent only if the ratio is shell-independent, and on the real O12/O13 pipeline its conjugate-block identity forces r = 1 within its contract; the earlier report of r in {1,2,3,4} to machine precision is a withdrawn historical claim, not an O16 result. O17's normalisation statement is internal to its toy model, and the O19 canonical normalisation is an open proposal. O16 asserts no numerical value of delta_pair. The conditional symmetric-square bound and the dictionary are unchanged.
